_meta.purpose: The stream-mode lever menu (menu v2, a dated pre-registered amendment of the INC lever menu). Every lever renders the exact command a person would run (levers_stream.argv); the executor re-renders it from the policy parameters (executor.ARGV_FORMS) and runs only what the policy table checked. It lives in its own file, not in levers.json, because diagnose.rules_version() hashes levers.json whole and brain_plan's menu lists its 'levers' block: stream rows there would change the experiment-mode rules version and brain digest (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Build notes, group F).
_meta.argv_template: levers.json's grammar: a plain string is literal; '{name}' inside a token is replaced by the param 'name'; {"if": name, "tokens": [...]} is rendered only when 'name' is given. '{pkg}' is the campaign's protocol_package (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md 4.3), an enum of the packages accepted under P11.
_meta.follow: What the lane waits on after the lever runs: 'lab' a detached lab process and its result file; 'job' a cluster job (squeue, then sacct); 'build' a build job, then the experiment it builds until it is built; 'experiment' a build job, then its experiment until it is done; 'login' nothing (the verb ran on the login node).

packages.why: Contract 4.3 and P11: the protocol packages a stream campaign may address; each is pinned as a unit at acceptance. tools.inc (v1) is not one: its never-train index refuses every 3SeasonWeedDet10 image (contract 2 D-A).

L16L.title: Collect one source on the lab (a provider not reachable from compute nodes), detached

L16RL.title: Collect on the lab a source that failed a pre-check (a person decides), detached

The cluster's collector refuses such a provider (not_placed_on_cluster, job 47302914), so L16R's sbatch can never succeed for it. Run by the lab fetch hook once a person approves; folded as an L16L run.

L16I.title: Intake a fetched source: normalise, class map, licence, guard
L16I.control: GuardV2 (never-train v2, base copy, near-duplicate), counted per reason.

L16S.title: Sync a lab-fetched source to the cluster, verified by sha256 on arrival

L17.name: admit
L17.title: Admit an intake batch through incremental Step 1 (one GPU-shared job)
L17.control: The frozen verifier (pinned sha) and the known-truth base copies (verified_precision).
L17.success: A committed batch: queue rows appended, status.json updated.
L17.falsifier: Known-truth precision with a Wilson lower bound < 0.99: a verifier refit is proposed (X11).
L17.note: Verb eval-hits (D28-v2, docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md amendment 2026-10-03): DR0 proposes it when a committed batch counts dHash hits on evaluation images that neither its own record nor a sidecar weighs (status.json eval_hits.due, an intake summary without intake/<batch>/eval_hits.json). It writes the sidecars (step1_stream/eval_hits/<batch>.json, intake/<batch>/eval_hits.json) and status.json, so D28 judges those sources by the amendment's rule; a batch it cannot give a sidecar fails the job (exit 2), never a silent re-proposal.

L18.name: segment
L18.title: Cut and build a segment of K fixed-size increments
L18.control: The incumbent P_{s-1} and the null arm under the same recipe (the pinned gate, read at commit by Protocol v3, L-3).

L18.note: The arm is the one choose-arm adopted (L-4) and the truth cadence is inc2.stream's own (ceil(cost/25), per segment); the build takes neither from the platform. --exp is the name the stream summary gives as next_segment, so a build that would make another experiment refuses. --recipes is for a person only: segment 1 runs init's Stage B arms, later segments the chosen recipe.

LH.title: Release (or keep) a funnel_F9 hold past its deadline (a person)

X13.title: Let the truth arm decide admission
X13.hypothesis: The cold truth arm is less noisy than the warm chain's gate on rare classes.
X13.why_menu_insufficient: D-D: the pinned gate decides every increment; the truth arm is evidence for attribution only (contract 5.4).
X13.required_change: A new protocol version in which truth verdicts admit data.
X13.cheapest_test: Re-read the recorded segments with truth as the decision and compare the pools.

X14.title: Raise the domain envelope, the allocation reserve, or renew the allocation
X14.hypothesis: The campaign's envelope, the domain's su_envelope or the allocation's end date binds.
X14.why_menu_insufficient: Budgets and allocations are an owner's decision.
X14.required_change: A person raises envelope_su, the domain budget, alloc_reserve_su, or renews the Bridges-2 allocation.

X15.title: Walltime limits bind the next build
X15.hypothesis: The pool has grown so that a run's projected time reaches 0.8 of its walltime.
X15.required_change: A new protocol version with longer limits, or disk-read tuning.
X15.cheapest_test: Time one cold run at the current pool size.
X15.success_criterion: The projection falls below 0.8 of the limit.

X16.title: Provider credentials or licence policy
X16.hypothesis: A source is blocked by missing credentials or an unresolved licence.
X16.why_menu_insufficient: Credentials and licence policy are a person's (P6).
X16.required_change: Rotate or provide the credential; decide the licence.

X17.title: M beyond the doubling rule, dev composition, or the species guard on a rare dev class
X17.hypothesis: The gate cannot accept increments at this M, or a rare dev class trips the species guard on noise.
X17.why_menu_insufficient: M changes only by L22 (at most 2 doublings); the gate, dev and the guard are pinned (D-D, L-3 is its own protocol version).
X17.required_change: An owner decision: a new protocol version of the guard or of dev, or a new M rule.
X17.cheapest_test: Stage C's known-good increment (L28) reads the guard's behaviour at M.
X17.control: Stage C and the segments' gate entries.
X17.success_criterion: Increments that the truth arm calls helpful are accepted.

X18.title: Fork the stream to a measurement arm read at its own resolution
X18.hypothesis: A measurement arm inferring at its training imgsz beats the stream's arm on dev, through the small prostrate weeds (capacity/native_v1.json qualifying).
X18.why_menu_insufficient: The stream's arm is the capacity decision's (L-4), and the gate, the milestones and the stream's comparisons are all scored by the locked scorer at 640 px: a fork at another resolution is a new protocol version.
X18.required_change: An owner decision: a scorer version at the arm's imgsz (relocked), then a stream version on that arm.
X18.success_criterion: Recorded by a person; the platform switches nothing and reads no test.

reused_cards.why: Contract 6.3: the recipe (Protocol v3), leave-one-source-out after a rollback, class policy and the verifier refit are the existing cards of levers.json.

limits._why: Contract 6.6 'Limits': these replace the blanket 3-per-campaign rule for the stream levers; L1-L14 keep it. Amendment 2026-10-04 (decided by the owner): the per-day counts are removed (L16 jobs_per_day 12 and gb_per_day 50, L17 jobs_per_day 6, L18 per_day 1). They only delayed healthy work: on 2026-10-04 the cluster sat idle about 9 h while the next segment was filed for a person because 'L18 already ran 1 time(s) in the last 24 h (limit 1)' (and a daily SU cap, removed with them). The fuses that never delay healthy work stay: in_flight, attempts_per_source, gb_per_source (a person may approve more) and the totals of L21, L22, L25, L27, L28 and LI.

gated_r2.why: Contract 6.5: these R2 data levers run directly only with data_autonomy on, a stream replay pass and the caps; otherwise they are filed for a person. Stricter than the R2 cell because a bug in the data lane could loop downloads.

envelope.why: Contract 6.5 and review: the R3 builds the envelope may approve (L21 only when its target is the rollback the last 'hurts' milestone recommended; LI, the stream's creation, only with Stage A's recorded arms; L23N, a done measurement arm's native-resolution rescore, one GPU job, 2026-10-01; L23V, E1's base v3 build, and L23E, E1's agnostic rescore, one GPU job each, 2026-10-03; L23C, E2's rescore and verdict, one GPU job, 2026-10-04; L23D, E2-C's attribution rescore, one GPU job, 2026-10-04, later; L23Z, the zoo audit, one held-free chain of five GPU-shared jobs within its 40 GPU-h cap, 2026-10-04). L23's splits build and lock always wait for a person (D-A's exact command).
